how_to_apply: Fill the bio-data in Annexure-I with a recent passport size photograph.
Application must be forwarded by the parent department through proper channel to the Development Commissioner, Noida SEZ.
Send within 45 days from the date of publication of the circular in the Employment News.
Enclose APARs for last five years, vigilance and integrity certificate, penalty details and cadre clearance.
Make sure it reaches by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NSEZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NSEZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 3 Preventive Officer (Customs), 2 Assistant, 1 Junior Hindi Translator.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NSEZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (Bio-Data) on page 4 of the circular) and send it to The Development Commissioner, Noida Special Economic Zone, Noida-Dadri Road, Phase-2, Noida - 201305 (Uttar Pradesh), by through proper channel by the parent department, to reach by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.9300-34800 Grade Pay Rs. 4600 equivalent to Level-7 of the Pay matrix under 7th CPC for Preventive Officer (Customs), Pay Band: Rs.9300-34800 Grade Pay Rs. 4200 equivalent to Level-6 of the Pay matrix under 7th CPC for Assistant, Pay Band: Rs.9300-34800 Grade Pay: Rs. 4200 equivalent to Level-6 of the Pay matrix under 7th CPC for Junior Hindi Translator.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Central Government officers holding analogous posts or with the prescribed regular service in lower grades. Assistant: Degree, word processing, typing 30 wpm English / 25 wpm Hindi. Junior Hindi Translator: Master's in Hindi/English or equivalent combinations with translation diploma or experience. Preventive Officer: CBEC officers with 2 years' Excise or Customs procedural work. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers who could be relieved in the event of selection may apply. Assistant: typing speed 30 wpm English or 25 wpm Hindi. Junior Hindi Translator: knowledge in word processing and use of Hindi software.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A Govt. Officer in a higher grade pay / scale is ineligible for deputation to a post in the lower grade pay / scale (DOPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay II) dt. 17.6.2010). Applications received after the last date, without confidential reports or incomplete will not be considered. Advance applications, even if received before the last date, will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of bio-data supported by documents by the Selection Committee. Bio-data duly supported by documents assessed by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on transfer on deputation basis for three years. Deputation period including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years. DoPT deputation rules, regulations and provisions apply.
